name: Tree rings
summary: The friend group as a tree stump seen from above: one ring per semester, as thick as that semester's plans, knots for the big moments and faces on the ring where each friend joined; tap a ring to read it, leave a leaf on your favorite, and carve your initials into the bark.
useWhen: how long have we been friends, show it
which semester was the best one for us
dontUseWhen: a map of the places we went (use plans-map)
chat stats like messages and emoji (use wrapped)
a before-and-after of the group (use then-now-wipe)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'The six, in tree rings'

rings.description: Semesters from the first (center) to now (outer), up to 10

plans.description: Plans the group locked that semester; sets the ring's thickness

moment.description: The moment that ring remembers, a few words

joined.description: When each friend joined the group

favs.description: Leaves already left on favorite rings
